description: Binance spot BTCUSDT 1-second klines, 2026-07-23..2026-09-06 UTC, one concatenated csv.gz for the whole window (same consolidation convention as this repo's existing binance_BTCUSDT_1m_* backtest_data builds -- see schema/external_crypto_klines.json). Built for P2-08b (docs/PHASE2/P2-08b/PREREG.md), the second-scale companion to the aggTrades files in schema/binance_aggtrades_p2_08b.json -- use this when per-second OHLCV is enough and aggTrades' per-print detail is not needed.
source: https://data.binance.vision/data/spot/daily/klines/BTCUSDT/1s/BTCUSDT-1s-YYYY-MM-DD.zip (public, unauthenticated). Fetched by scripts/fetch_binance_vision.py --interval 1s --start-day 2026-07-23 --end-day 2026-09-06 (exact day-range mode, daily archives only -- no monthly lookup, so the file holds exactly this window and nothing outside it).

n_trades.meaning: number of raw trades in the bar
n_trades.notes: a 1-second bar with n_trades=0 means no trade printed that second -- treat as 'no observation', not 'price unchanged' (P2-08b known defect #4)

taker_buy_base.meaning: base-asset volume from taker-buy-initiated trades in the bar

known_defects: a second with n_trades=0 is a genuine non-observation (see column note above), not a flat/unchanged price -- matches the same convention applied to bitFlyer's own execution-derived series in this study
this is spot only -- see schema/binance_aggtrades_p2_08b.json for the futures/um contrast series, which is not mirrored at 1s-kline granularity (aggTrades only)
